recentContext.content: CRITICAL SUNO CAPTURE FIX (2026-09-02): MediaRecorder captures DEGRADED (lowpassed ~300Hz sine) audio from Suno song pages in batch/automated runs. The WORKING method: (1) generate cover fresh, (2) capture IMMEDIATELY within ~30 min of clip creation, (3) get metadata duration first, (4) play via SINGLE main-track play button (aria-label=Play, y<500), (5) MediaRecorder for exactly metadata_duration+3s, (6) ffmpeg webm->mp3. Verify quality via spectral centroid (>2000 = real cover, ~330 = sine/degraded). Helper: gen_capture_genre.py + cap_final.py. NEVER click all play buttons (queues wrong track).
